chain.label: Fatigue crack initiates in fan blade No. 13 dovetail
chain.trigger: a low-cycle fatigue crack in the dovetail of fan blade No. 13

chain.label: 2012 overhaul FPI and subsequent visual inspections fail to detect the dovetail crack
chain.trigger: the overhaul process included a fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) to detect cracks; however, the crack was not detected for unknown reasons

caused_by.evidence: this crack was most likely not detectable during the fluorescent penetrant inspection at the time of the fan blade set's last overhaul and subsequent visual inspections at the time of fan blade relubrications

chain.label: Fan blade No. 13 fractures at the root and separates in flight, impacting the fan case
chain.trigger: the fan blade separating in flight and impacting the engine fan case at a location that was critical to the structural integrity and performance of the fan cowl structure

caused_by.evidence: a low-cycle fatigue crack in the dovetail of fan blade No. 13, which resulted in the fan blade separating in flight

the requirement to perform an eddy current inspection at the time of fan blade overhaul and an ultrasonic inspection at the time of blade relubrication should enable cracked fan blades in CFM56-7B engines to be detected and removed from service before the cracks reach a critical size and the blades fracture

chain.label: FBO loads transmitted through the radial restraint fitting crack and sever the fan cowl latch assemblies, cowl halves separate
chain.trigger: the impact of the separated fan blade with the fan case imparted significant loads into the fan cowl through the radial restraint fitting

caused_by.evidence: impacting the engine fan case at a location that was critical to the structural integrity and performance of the fan cowl structure

chain.label: Departing fan cowl aft latch keeper fragment strikes fuselage near cabin window, window departs, cabin rapidly depressurizes
chain.trigger: the impact of the inboard fan cowl aft latch keeper with the fuselage near the cabin window adjacent to seat 14A caused the window to depart the airplane, the rapid depressurization of the cabin

caused_by.evidence: the in-flight separation of fan cowl components, including the inboard fan cowl aft latch keeper, which struck the fuselage near a cabin window

chain.label: Passenger in seat 14A partially pulled through the window opening and fatally injured; 8 other passengers receive minor injuries
chain.trigger: 1 passenger received fatal injuries, and 8 passengers received minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: caused the window to depart the airplane, the cabin to rapidly depressurize, and the passenger fatality

chain.label: Flight crew conducts emergency descent and makes a safe single-engine landing at Philadelphia
chain.trigger: the flight crew conducted an emergency descent and diverted to Philadelphia International Airport... The airplane landed safely at PHL about 17 minutes after the engine failure occurred

caused_by.evidence: As a result of the engine failure, the flight crew conducted an emergency descent and diverted to Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)
